description: La liste des stations des bus de la SRT Bizerte is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Société régionale de transport de Bizerte (SRTB). Ce jeu de données présente les différentes stations de Bus de la SRTB. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Société régionale de transport de Bizerte (SRTB). It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLS. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
